remarks: An open main level, an upstairs loft and an eight-foot sliding glass door give this Caspian Villas townhome room for both gathering and getting away. Approximately 1,632 square feet include three upstairs bedrooms, two upstairs bathrooms and a convenient downstairs powder room. White cabinetry and streamlined countertops complement the connected kitchen, dining and living spaces, creating a welcoming setting for everyday meals and weekend company. Make the loft your home office, movie lounge or reading retreat, then step outside to the patio for a change of pace. Indoor laundry, central heating and air conditioning, and an attached two-car garage bring comfort and convenience to daily life.
